snippet.title: The Cabin Game - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Take a look at the Reveal Trailer for The Cabin Game, a chaotic psychological horror co-op game developed by Twisted Corridor. Players will find themselves trapped inside a cabin, with a simple yet deadly game of cards proving to be the only means of escape. The Cabin Game is coming soon to PC (Steam).

#TheCabinGame #Gaming #IGN
